paragraphs: NoTraffic sells a platform for signalized intersections, pitched as a way to modernize cities by transforming those intersections into a connected digital transportation network. The platform is presented in parts: edge devices and smart sensors powered by AI, cloud-based intersection management, and mobility applications for current and future needs. Alongside the hardware and software, the company offers a US-based 24/7 managed service from an operations center.

The site addresses agencies, saying NoTraffic empowers agencies to optimize infrastructure, enhance efficiency, and improve safety. Deployments named on the page include Tucson, Phoenix, Kelowna, Arlington, Huntsville, Sugar Land, and a campus at UBC. The site also states that the platform is approved and operates in 40 states.

quote.text: Modernize cities by transforming signalized intersections into a connected digital transportation network that enhances efficiency, assures safety, and maximizes infrastructure utilization
